scenes.say: Ever had a data pipeline suddenly fail? What causes schema drift, and how do you catch it before it breaks things?

scenes.label: Drift
scenes.sub: Schema drift is when your data structure changes unexpectedly.
scenes.say: Schema drift is when your data structure changes without warning. It can break downstream processes fast.
To spot drift, monitor schema versions, set up alerts for changes, and coordinate updates with upstream teams.

scenes.title: Alert on Schema Change
scenes.say: Here's a real example. A new column appears in the orders table. The system triggers an alert, so you know to update your transformations.

scenes.question: Why does schema drift matter?
scenes.wrong: It only affects raw data storage.
scenes.right: It can break pipelines and downstream apps, so early detection keeps data flowing.
scenes.say: Watch out in interviews. Schema drift isn't just about storage. It can break pipelines and dashboards—so early detection is key.
